entities.name: Volodymyr Kubijovyč
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Volodymyr Kubijovyč was a well-known anthropological geographer in prewar Polish-ruled Western Ukraine, a leading wartime Ukrainian nationalist politician who collaborated with German authorities, and an important post-war émigré intellectual of mixed Ukrainian-Polish background.
